postings.title: Senior RF Test Engineer
top_requirements: Hands‑on experience designing, building, and characterizing RF test fixtures and measurement setups for microwave frequencies.
Ability to program and operate automated test equipment (e.g., VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generators) and write test scripts in Python or LabVIEW.
Proficiency in soldering and debugging of high‑frequency PCBs, including 0201 component placement and RF connector troubleshooting.
bonus_skills: RF safety and OTA chamber procedures
Familiarity with RF PCB layout review
postings.summary: The role focuses on developing and executing RF test plans for Tanisha’s products, which aligns with the candidate’s extensive RF test background in satellite communications. It offers a hands‑on engineering environment, though compensation is below the target range.

postings.title: Senior RF Design Engineer
top_requirements: Design and verification of high‑performance RF front‑end circuits (LNAs, mixers, PLLs) for active‑grid‑response sensors.
Perform full RF link‑budget analysis, noise figure, IIP3, and EVM measurements on prototype boards.
Lead hardware bring‑up, including PCB layout, component selection, and production testing of RF modules.
postings.summary: Gridware needs senior RF designers to create the RF front‑ends for its next‑generation grid‑monitoring platform, a perfect match for the candidate’s communications‑system and RF design expertise. The salary range meets the target compensation.

postings.title: Radio Frequency Hardware Engineer - DoorDash Air
top_requirements: Develop and integrate RF hardware for robotic perception systems, including high‑speed transceivers and phased‑array front‑ends.
Perform system‑level RF validation in harsh robotic environments and certify compliance with FCC/CE standards.
Collaborate with AI/ML teams to co‑design RF‑aware signal‑processing pipelines for low‑latency data links.
postings.summary: DoorDash Labs seeks a senior RF engineer to embed advanced RF capabilities into its autonomous‑delivery robots, a role that blends the candidate’s communications and RF design skills with a new industry focus. Compensation aligns with the target range.

postings.title: Senior RF Test Engineer
top_requirements: Develop RF hardware for overhead sensor modules, including transceiver design, PCB layout, and antenna integration (non‑custom antenna design).
Create automated test setups to validate sensor RF performance (range, accuracy, interference rejection).
Work closely with software/AI teams to define RF signal requirements for real‑time analytics.
postings.summary: Radar’s hardware‑enabled SaaS platform needs a senior RF engineer to build and test the RF front‑ends of its store‑level sensors, aligning well with the candidate’s communications and RF test background. Compensation meets the target.

postings.title: Sr. RF/Wireless Engineer
top_requirements: Perform certification‑level RF testing and compliance verification for wireless products.
Develop test procedures and scripts for spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and OTA chambers.
Document test results and generate reports for regulatory submissions.
postings.summary: TÜV SÜD’s senior RF/Wireless Engineer role focuses on testing and certification, matching the candidate’s RF test expertise, though the salary is modest.

postings.title: RF Design Engineer – Next-Gen Wireless
top_requirements: Lead the design of RF front‑ends for Apple consumer products, including LNAs, power amplifiers, and duplexers.
Drive silicon bring‑up, perform on‑chip S‑parameter and linearity measurements, and iterate layout for performance targets.
Mentor junior engineers and define RF design guidelines across multiple product families.
postings.summary: Apple’s RF Design team offers a senior role that directly involves hands‑on RF IC design and validation, perfectly aligning with the candidate’s goal to move into senior IC positions. Compensation is within the desired range.
